description: This line plot, titled "Massive Activation of atten_output_gate," illustrates the maximum activation values across layers for four distinct gating configurations within a neural network architecture. The x-axis represents the "Layer" number, ranging from 0 to approximately 25, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 5 units. The y-axis represents the "Max Activation Value," scaled linearly from 0 to 400. The plot displays four lines: a blue dashed line labeled "atten_output," a green dashed line labeled "ffn_output," an orange dotted line labeled "atten_residual," and a red solid line labeled "ffn_residual." The "atten_output" line begins near 0, rises gradually to approximately 35 at layer 20, and then sharply increases to nearly 400 by layer 25. The "ffn_output" line remains near 0 until layer 20, after which it rises steeply to approximately 160 by layer 25. The "atten_residual" line remains near 0 until layer 20, then rises sharply to approximately 250 by layer 25. The "ffn_residual" line begins near 0, rises gradually to approximately 50 at layer 15, and then increases sharply to nearly 400 by layer 25.
